name: @cobblr/sandboxed-bricklink
description: Sandboxed AssemblyScript port of bricklink-connector. Proof that v0.3 handles a real domain module — XML/CSV parsing in wasm + cross-module reads against inventory:parts.

scripts.build: npm run vendor-sdk && asc assembly/index.ts --outFile module.wasm --runtime incremental --bindings raw --exportRuntime
